name: pr-check__10-node-placement
text:
---
description: >-
  A reduced, four-lane fragment of the support-ticket escalation flow (Sales,
  Technical support, Tester, Development) with the Sales lane declared first
  in the source even though it is downstream in the edge flow, exercising
  node/lane placement when declaration order does not match graph order.
config:
  logLevel: 0
  htmlLabels: false
  flowchart:
    useMaxWidth: false
---
swimlane-beta LR

  subgraph S["Sales"]
  T5["Confirm with customer"]
  end

  subgraph T["Technical support"]
  T4["Get more details from customer"]
  T6["Resolve solution"]
  end

  subgraph Tester["Tester"]
  Te2{"Reproduced the issue"}
  D4{"Resolved?"}
  end

  subgraph D["Development"]
  D1["Error report"]
  D2["Technical analysis"]
  D3["Fix the issue"]

  end

  %% Edges



  Te2 -- Yes --> D1 --> D2 --> D3 --> D4
  Te2 -- No --> T4

  D4 -- No --> D2
  D4 -- Yes --> T6 --> T5
